summary: Talen Energy filed an 8-K announcing CEO succession. Terry L. Nutt, currently President, was named CEO effective Jan 1, 2027, joining the board; he signed a second amended employment agreement. Current CEO Mark A. McFarland gave notice to step down as CEO and director on that date, then serve as Senior Advisor until retirement Mar 1, 2027 under a transition agreement. No disagreement or Item 404 relationships were disclosed. The event is an orderly, pre-announced leadership transition rather than a forced departure; watch interim execution, retention terms, and any strategic shifts before the handoff.
